# Boss drop fixtures

These abbreviated HTML fixtures are derived from OSRS Wiki contributors' pages fetched on 2026-10-04. Each file links to its exact source revision. Tables retain selected real rows, headings, conditions, and referenced footnotes so parser tests can run without live requests.

The Wiki-derived content in these fixtures is licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/), as described by the [OSRS Wiki licensing notice](https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/RuneScape:Copyrights). The fixtures have been shortened for testing; this notice applies to their Wiki content, not the application's original source code. Image URLs reference Wiki-hosted assets; image files are not bundled here.
